policy.evidenceAccountingRule: not-collected is never evidence; source test signals are availability hints only
policy.independentAcceptanceRule: accepted only after machine qualification, complete independent-reviewer provenance, and an independent accepted verdict
policy.machineQualificationRule: qualified only after all requirements for all three stages and all non-review episode requirements are complete

stopGo.rule: allow only when at least 48 candidates have complete three-stage transition, commit, prefix, repository, license, replay, and independent-review closure
